summary: Phase 3 RankTrust handoff webhook verified end-to-end. 12/12 pytest passed (HMAC + token auth, tampered-body rejection, unauthorized zero-DB-write, needs_phone flow, scheduled_calls row, idempotency, delay validation, kill-switch/DNC gating, happy-path dial, callback-body secret redaction, GET redaction). 33/33 combined regression with outbound gate suite. Live mount + scheduler-started log confirmed. Live auth gate returns 401 fail-closed (no secret/token/hmac configured) with zero DB writes. No secret leaks in logs. Legacy /api/twilio/inbound* and /api/tts/generate untouched. Code review: constant-time HMAC + token compare, short-circuit before any DB read, callback response body not logged verbatim, callback_token stripped in _public_view.
critical_code_review_comments: start_scheduler() uses asyncio.get_event_loop() which is deprecated in Py3.12+; consider asyncio.get_running_loop() or defer to on_event('startup'). Non-blocking today because it's invoked from within a running loop at startup, but worth cleaning up before Py3.12.

scheduler_tick_once atomic claim uses update_one on {packet_id, status:'pending'} — this is per-packet-safe but not per-scheduled-row unique if the same packet_id ever produced two rows (currently prevented by idempotency). Fine as-is; document invariant.

asyncio.create_task(_post_callback(...)) is fire-and-forget with no reference retained — if the loop is shut down or task GC'd early, the callback could be dropped. Low risk in supervisor-managed long-running process, but consider a task registry or a lightweight outbox for durability.
test_credentials: n/a — RANKTRUST_HANDOFF_SECRET/TOKEN intentionally unset to verify fail-closed 401 behavior
seed_data_creation: none — mongomock in-memory for pytest; real DB verified empty (0 handoffs / 0 scheduled) after unauthorized live curls
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webhook fully additive. To exercise live happy-path, set RANKTRUST_HANDOFF_SECRET or RANKTRUST_HANDOFF_TOKEN in /app/backend/.env, restart backend, and POST to /api/webhooks/ranktrust/handoff. Kill-switch file (OUTBOUND_DISABLED) and Phase D live-dial are still owner-gated — DO NOT touch. Combined regression command: cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py tests/test_ranktrust_webhook.py -q (expect 33 passed).
